Urologist

Main areas of specialisation

  • Benign prostatic hyperplasia
  • Prostate cancer
  • Bladder cancer
  • Cancer of the penis
  • Kidney cancer
  • Varicocele
  • Urinary stone disease

Summary

Professor Nicola Mabjeesh is a specialist in urology and urological surgery. He treats a wide range of conditions of the urinary and reproductive organs, including cancers. He makes extensive use of endoscopic and robotic technologies, which ensure rapid recovery for patients and an excellent aesthetic result after surgery.

The doctor advises patients from Israel and abroad at the Assuta clinic, where he also performs operations to remove benign prostatic hyperplasia and prostate cancer, bladder tumours and others.

Education and clinical experience

  • 2019: Private practice at the Assuta clinic
  • 2010: Deputy head of the urology department, Ichilov clinic
  • 2003: Senior physician, urology department, Ichilov clinic
  • 2000: Residency in urological surgery at the Ichilov clinic
  • 1998: Residency in urological surgery at the Shaare Zedek hospital
  • 1992: Internship at the Ziv clinic
  • 1990: Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University

Academic and research work

Professor Mabjeesh teaches in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University. He is also the author of many research papers published in international professional journals. The subjects of his work include:

  • The use of brachytherapy in treating prostate cancer;
  • Research into the role of biomarkers in planning the treatment of bladder cancer;
  • The use of gene therapy in treating prostate cancer;
  • Organ-preserving treatment of kidney cancer;
  • Staging of prostate cancer;
  • Performing diagnostic cystoscopy with the least possible discomfort, and others.

Membership of medical associations

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Urological Association
  • Israel Association for Cancer Research

Urologist, uro-oncologist, urological surgeon

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Surgical treatment of urological conditions
  • Minimally invasive treatment of cancer
  • Laparoscopic surgery
  • Diagnosis and treatment of prostate cancer
  • Diagnosis and treatment of testicular cancer
  • Diagnosis and treatment of bladder cancer
  • Diagnosis and treatment of kidney tumours

Summary: Professor Ofer Yossepowitch is a leading Israeli urological surgeon and uro-oncologist, a recognised specialist of international standing in the diagnosis and treatment of cancers in urology. He works at the Assuta clinic and has an excellent academic background.

Professor Yossepowitch successfully combines clinical practice with serious research, devoting much time to the search for and development of innovative treatments for urological conditions. He has published more than 70 substantial papers on uro-oncology in leading international medical journals.

Professor Yossepowitch is an honorary member and invited expert of the American Urological Association and a member of the Israel Medical Association. He has received prestigious prizes from international uro-oncological societies.

Professor Yossepowitch also teaches in the faculty of surgery at Tel Aviv University and presents actively at Israeli and international conferences and symposia.

Education:

  • Hebrew University medical school, Jerusalem, Israel
  • Fellowship at the Hadassah medical centre, Jerusalem, Israel
  • Residency in urological surgery at the Rabin Medical Centre, Israel
  • Service in the Israel Defence Forces as a military doctor with an infantry brigade
  • Fellowship in the surgical treatment of urological cancers at the research institute of the Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • American Urological Association

Immunologist, rheumatologist

Main areas of specialisation

  • Treatment of chronic inflammatory joint disease
  • Treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and coxarthrosis
  • Treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus
  • Treatment of scleroderma
  • Allergy

Summary

Professor Pnina Langevitz is a leading rheumatologist and immunologist of world class with more than 40 years of clinical experience. She is a recognised expert in the treatment of rheumatological and autoimmune disease. Professor Langevitz applies advanced methods of diagnosis and treatment that she has developed herself. These methods make it possible to manage conditions traditionally considered incurable, reducing the frequency of relapse and the severity of symptoms.

Each year thousands of patients from around the world come to Professor Langevitz for help. They gain access to the newest therapies, which are not yet in use at other clinics. Professor Langevitz is actively engaged in research, developing and introducing new effective treatments for rheumatic disease.

For twelve years Pnina Langevitz held the honoured post of vice-president of the international rheumatology association. She is also editor-in-chief of the international medical journal Lupus, devoted to systemic lupus erythematosus.

Education and clinical experience

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship in rheumatology at the Assuta clinic, Israel

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Medical Association
  • International association of rheumatologists

Professor Pnina Langevitz combines many years of experience, advanced knowledge and distinctive techniques, which makes her one of the world's leading specialists in rheumatology and immunology.

  11. Chromosomal and genetic disorders causing skull deformity
  12. Diagnosis of genetic disorders of the foetal central nervous system

Summary

Professor Shlomo Constantini is an exceptional and gifted doctor, rightly considered one of the world's best neurosurgeons. He specialises in treating children and adults with disorders of the brain and spinal cord. For more than 35 years this unrivalled and highly professional surgeon has performed extraordinarily complex operations that have quite literally given thousands of patients their lives back.

For many, paediatric neurosurgery in Israel is associated unambiguously with the name of Professor Constantini, so great is his contribution to the establishment and development of this field of medicine. He has headed the paediatric neurosurgery department for 22 years. He is also a leading teacher in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University and at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.

Shlomo Constantini is a well-known and respected scientist. The key aim of his research is the search for the newest and most advanced treatments for disorders of the brain and spinal cord. He holds numerous prestigious international prizes and awards for his contribution to neurosurgery worldwide.

Education

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Specialisation in general and paediatric neurosurgery at the Hadassah clinic, Jerusalem, Israel
  • Fellowship in paediatric neurosurgery at New York University, USA

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations

  • Founder and head of the international society of neuroendoscopy
  • Israel Neurosurgical Society
  • Vice-president of the European Association of Neurosurgical Societies (EANS)
  • European Society for Paediatric Neurosurgery (ESPN)
  • American Association of Neurological Surgeons (AANS)
  • American society for disorders of the nervous system (NTS)
  • Chairman of the International Society for Pediatric Neurosurgery (ISPN)

Professor Shlomo Schneebaum: an expert of world class in oncology and surgery

Professional overview: Professor Shlomo Schneebaum, head of the breast unit at the Assuta clinic in Israel, stands out among other specialists for his distinctive approach to the treatment and study of breast cancer, melanoma, carcinoma and adenocarcinoma.

Main specialisations:

  • Breast cancer: developing individual treatment strategies.
  • Melanoma: applying the newest methods of diagnosis and treatment.
  • Mastectomy: use of minimally invasive techniques.
  • Carcinoma and adenocarcinoma: innovative approaches to treatment.

Clinical path:

  • Sourasky Medical Centre, Tel Aviv: residency.
  • Sheba clinic: senior physician, general surgery department.
  • University of Illinois and Ohio State University, USA: research.
  • Assuta Medical Centre: head of the surgery department.

Academic and research achievements:

  • Publications: author of more than 73 research papers in international journals.
  • Teaching: active work at Tel Aviv University and Ohio State University.
  • European board of surgical oncology: chairmanship, which confirms his influence in the field.

Membership of international associations: Professor Schneebaum takes an active part in the work of leading medical associations, including:

  • Israel Society for Breast Disease
  • Israel Society of Surgical Oncology
  • Israel Surgical Association
  • International society for the treatment of breast disease
  • Society for Thermal Medicine, USA
  • European Association for Cancer Research
  • Israel Society of Colorectal Surgery
  • Society of Surgical Oncology, USA

This membership underlines his deep commitment to improving medical practice and to exchanging professional experience internationally.

Professor Schneebaum remains at the front line of the fight against cancer, giving patients access to the most advanced treatments and hope of recovery. His work not only saves lives but makes a significant contribution to the global medical community.

Leading specialist in invasive cardiology and minimally invasive cardiac surgery

Education and fellowships:

  • Has headed the catheterisation department at the Sheba clinic for more than 30 years.
  • Head of the catheterisation department at the Assuta clinic, and the founder of both departments.
  • Specialisation in diagnostic catheterisation and percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty.
  • Lecturer at Tel Aviv University.

Areas of work:

  • Minimally invasive cardiac surgery.
  • Catheterisation of the coronary arteries.
  • Minimally invasive cardiology.

Particular distinctions:

  • Performed the first successful therapeutic catheterisation in Israel.

Languages:
